type.matchUserType: Move's type always matches the user's primary type.
type.weatherBall: Move's type changes based on the weather (like Weather Ball).
type.terrainPulse: Move's type changes based on the terrain (like Terrain Pulse).
type.hiddenPower: Move's type changes based on the user's characteristics (like Hidden Power).
type.becomeTypeless: Become Typeless (always neutral damage) and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
type.superEffectiveVsType: Always deal Super Effective damage against {{targetTypeName}} type Pokémon.

heal.addINGRAINVsPower: User recovers 1/16 max HP per turn for 5 turns and cannot switch out (Ingrain effect), but decrease Power by {{powerValue}}.
heal.addINGRAINOnly: User recovers 1/16 max HP per turn for 5 turns and cannot switch out (Ingrain effect).
heal.addAQUA_RINGVsPower: User recovers 1/16 max HP per turn for 5 turns (Aqua Ring effect), but decrease Power by {{powerValue}}.
heal.addAQUA_RINGOnly: User recovers 1/16 max HP per turn for 5 turns (Aqua Ring effect).
heal.addPlantHeal: User recovers HP if Grassy Terrain is active. Fails if Grassy Terrain is not active.
heal.addSandHeal: User recovers HP if Sandstorm is active. Fails if Sandstorm is not active.

sacrificial.upgradeOnHit: Sacrifice HP only on hit, Base Power becomes {{power}}, Base Accuracy becomes {{newAccuracy}}%.
sacrificial.upgradeOnHitNoAccuracy: Sacrifice HP only on hit, Base Power becomes {{power}}.

crit.upgradeToCritOnly: Only critical hits, Base Power becomes {{newPower}}, Base Accuracy becomes {{newAccuracy}}%.
crit.upgradeToCritOnlyNoAccuracy: Only critical hits, Base Power becomes {{newPower}}.

confusion.addChanceVsPower: Add a {{chance}}% chance to confuse the target, but decrease Power by {{powerValue}}.

curse.addChanceVsPower: Add a {{chance}}% chance to curse the target (loses 1/4 max HP per turn), but decrease Power by {{powerValue}}.

flags.ignoreProtect: Move can now hit through Protect/Detect, but decrease Power by {{powerValue}}.
flags.ignoreAbilities: Move now ignores target's Abilities, and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
flags.soundBased: Move becomes Sound-based (hits through Substitute) and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
flags.punchingMove: Move becomes a Punching move (boosted by Iron Fist) and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
flags.slicingMove: Move becomes a Slicing move (boosted by Sharpness) and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
flags.pulseMove: Move becomes a Pulse move (boosted by Mega Launcher) and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
flags.bitingMove: Move becomes a Biting move (boosted by Strong Jaw) and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
flags.windMove: Move becomes a Wind move (affected by Wind Rider/Power) and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
flags.ballBombMove: Move becomes a Ball/Bomb move and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
flags.powderMove: Move becomes a Powder move and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
flags.danceMove: Move becomes a Dance move and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
flags.disableContact: Move no longer makes contact, and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
flags.enableContact: Move now makes contact, and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
flags.ignoreStatChanges: Move now ignores target's defensive stat changes and evasion, and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
flags.removeScreens: Move now removes Reflect/Light Screen/Aurora Veil, and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.

priority.increase: Priority becomes +{{value}}, Base Power becomes {{newPower}}, Base Accuracy becomes {{newAccuracy}}%.
priority.decrease: Priority becomes {{value}}, Base Power becomes {{newPower}}, Base Accuracy becomes {{newAccuracy}}%.
priority.conditionalTerrain: Increase Priority to {{value}} if {{terrain}} Terrain is active, and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
priority.conditionalFirstTurn: Fails if not first turn, Increase Priority to {{value}}, and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.

misc.addTrap: Traps the target with {{trapName}} for several turns, but decrease Power by {{powerValue}}.
misc.addSwitchOut: User switches out after use, but decrease Power by {{powerValue}} (like U-Turn).
misc.addGrounding: Grounds airborne targets (removes Flying type immunity).
misc.fixedDamageLevel: Change damage calculation to deal damage equal to the user's level (replaces base power).
misc.fixedDamageValue: Change damage calculation to deal fixed {{value}} HP damage.
misc.fixedDamageTargetHalfHp: Change damage calculation to deal damage equal to half the target's current HP (replaces base power).
misc.addSurviveDamage: Always leaves the target with at least 1 HP (like False Swipe), and increase Power by {{powerValue}}.
misc.addWeightPowerTarget: Power increases based on the target's weight (like Low Kick).
misc.addWeightPowerCompare: Power increases the heavier the user is compared to the target (like Heavy Slam).
misc.addSpeedPowerSlower: Power increases the slower the user is compared to the target (like Gyro Ball).
misc.addSpeedPowerFaster: Power increases the faster the user is compared to the target (like Electro Ball).
misc.addHpPowerHighHp: Power increases the higher the user's current HP.
misc.addHpPowerLowHp: Power increases the lower the user's current HP (like Reversal).
misc.addChargeTurn: Add a charge turn before attacking, Base Power becomes {{newPower}}, Base Accuracy becomes {{newAccuracy}}%.
misc.addChargeTurnWithBoost: Add a charge turn (raises user's {{statName}} by {{stages}} stage(s)), Base Power becomes {{newPower}}, Base Accuracy becomes {{newAccuracy}}%.
misc.addStealItemChance: {{chance}}% chance to steal target's held item, Base Power becomes {{newPower}}.
misc.addStealItemGuaranteed: Steal target's held item (100% chance), Base Power becomes {{newPower}}.
misc.addRemoveItem: Remove target's held item, Base Power becomes {{newPower}}.
misc.powerBoostTerrain: Power doubles if {{terrain}} Terrain is active and the target is grounded.
misc.powerBoostConsecutive: Power doubles with each consecutive successful use (max 4x).
misc.powerBoostTurnDamaged: Power doubles if the user was damaged by the target this turn.

statusSpecific.setWeather: Changes the weather to {{weather}}. Move fails if {{weather}} is already active.
statusSpecific.setTerrain: Changes the terrain to {{terrain}}. Move fails if {{terrain}} Terrain is already active.
statusSpecific.addArenaTrap: Sets {{trapName}} trap on the opponent's side of the field. Move fails if {{trapName}} is already active.
